$(m-n)/6=\frac{1}{6}m-\frac{1}{6}n$, so it is a polynomial.  
$\frac{3}{\pi}+a$ has constant denominator $\pi$, so it is a polynomial.  
$\frac{5}{a-b}$ has a variable denominator, so it is not a polynomial.  
$2(x^2-4)=2x^2-8$ is a polynomial.  
Thus, there are $4$ polynomials.

\boxed{4}
